description: List and filter carrier pickup points (CDEK, Yandex, KIT, Energia, etc.) available in a destination city_id (use search_cities first). Pass the chosen pickup_point_id, pickup_point_carrier_id and address into estimate_delivery or checkout.

carrier.description: Optional carrier name filter (case-insensitive substring, e.g. 'СДЭК', 'Яндекс', 'КИТ').

city_id.description: Destination city ID from search_cities (e.g. 414 = Moscow).

limit.description: Maximum pickup points to return (default 20, max 50).

name: search_pickup_points

carrier_id.description: Pass as pickup_point_carrier_id to estimate_delivery or checkout.

cod.description: True when cash/card on delivery is available at this point.

pickup_point_id.description: Pass as pickup_point_id to estimate_delivery or checkout.

price.description: Indicative base delivery price for a standard parcel; use estimate_delivery for exact cart pricing.
